passenger_response.subject: Your claim for flight AK155
passenger_response.body:
Dear Daniel Fitzgerald,

Our record shows that flight AK155 on 2026-08-06 was delayed because of an avionics fault, which was rectified at the stand. The delay at your final destination was 195 minutes. This is the delay used to assess compensation, rather than the 215-minute departure delay.

We have worked out what you are owed and we agree you are owed it. Releasing the payment is not something this desk can do on its own, so it has gone to someone who can. No money has moved yet.

The amount assessed is GBP 220.00.

The delay also entitled you to meals and refreshments up to GBP 30.00 per passenger per 6 hours, two calls or equivalent, a hotel up to GBP 180.00 per room per night for up to 3 nights, subject to station allocation, and transport up to GBP 45.00 per journey.

Kind regards
passenger_response.note: Draft only. The operations API exposes no send operation, so this text has not reached the passenger.
